body: Added a 'Founder Real-Time Direction' section (route through emily observe first, then sprint-plan into EMILY/BACKLOG.md, then implement — pointing to THE_EMILY_WAY.md Principle 18) to every CLAUDE.md in the monorepo: APPLES, EDIS, EINHORN_SURVIVAL, EmilyOS, GOLDENBAND, gpt2-alpine-c, GTA7, IDUNA, MJOLNIR, NORN, OKEMILY, PITVIPER, PRRJECT_FATBABY, QUEENSALLYONLINEBOOKOFMAGIFICATIONANDUNICOR, REDGARDEN, shankpit-460, SHANKPIT, TYLER, WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS (19 repos) -- root/EMILY/emily.cli already had it from earlier this session. Skipped fix/REDGARDEN and redgarden-deploy: both are separate local clones of the same REDGARDEN git remote (not independent repos), editing all three would risk push conflicts -- only the canonical REDGARDEN/ was touched. All 18 remaining repos committed + pushed cleanly.
title: Founder Real-Time Direction protocol propagated to all 20 CLAUDE.md files
